{{Top}}
A '''container ship''' was a massive commercial [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel. Although slow and expensive, they were considered to be the most efficient means of cargo transport when dealing with large loads.

Container ships were used by the [[Old Republic shipping fleet]]; when [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] made the [[P2-series astromech droid]] available exclusively to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on a trial basis, the P2 units proved to be capable maintenance units aboard the vessels.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Super Transport XI]] was a container ship.
